title: [review] site.py:192: PathCapable resource silently ignored
description: SentMessageDetailsResource (PathCapable) is added to the same path as SentMessagesResource. Due to aiocoap behavior, when a PathCapable resource is added to an already-occupied path, the add is silently ignored. Confirmed via test: only SentMessagesResource is registered at ('msg', 'sent'). The detail endpoint GET /msg/sent/{id} is non-functional.
close_reason: Fixed: Register PathCapable resource (SentMessageDetailsResource) BEFORE non-PathCapable resource (SentMessagesResource) at the same path. aiocoap requires this ordering for both collection and sub-path routing to work correctly.
